artboards.title: Spoke 1 · Tank Recon — step rail on the right
Spoke 1 · same screen — breadcrumb-stepper across the top

annotations.text:
BREADCRUMB — pick one.
Left: right-hand rail. Keeps all four steps visible with room for detail under each, but costs 250px of width.
Right: top stepper. Full-width content, reads left-to-right like the work does — but each step gets one line only.
Both screens carry the SAME breadcrumb line above (Bunk View › Tank Recon). The stepper is the addition — it answers "how far through am I", which a breadcrumb alone does not.

Every figure is Sri Balaji's real data from 25-26 Aug: the three tanks on their corrected charts, the twelve nozzle names off their pump serials, and the Rs 1,25,275.25 standing against Nagamani, Premalatha and Manisha.
